name: Rehome existing durable reports and recaps into person Journal
description: CLASSIFICATION: V0/V1 outcome parity for seeing what the supported person learned. Reuse existing durable report/recap artifacts and rehome them in the authorized person Journal; do not build a second generation or analytics system.
acceptanceCriteria: MINIMUM LAUNCH OUTCOME: person Journal lists existing report/recap artifacts the caller is authorized to see; announcements deep-link to the durable artifact; accepted visibility is enforced server-side and pending/revoked relationships deny; loading, empty, and stale-link states are explicit; a seeded journey proves multiple existing artifacts survive relaunch. DEFERRED: new report types, generalized infinite history, and new generation schedules.
riskImpact: A supporter can link successfully yet cannot perform the core promised outcome of understanding the person's learning; authorization mistakes disclose learning data.
